meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: Claude 会在 macOS 菜单栏添加一个带圆点的螺栓图标，绿点表示 NanoClaw 正在运行，红点表示已停止；点击图标可开始、停止或重启服务。仅适用于 macOS。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 macOS 菜单栏状态指示器时触发。仅限 macOS 系统。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加一个菜单栏状态图标。
say.note: Claude 会检查环境并安装状态栏。

say.text: 帮我加一个 macOS 状态栏指示器，显示 NanoClaw 是否在运行。
say.note: 如果已安装，会直接验证并提示。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude add a menu bar icon on macOS: a bolt icon with a green/red dot showing whether NanoClaw is running, plus Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. macOS only.

say_en.text: Show NanoClaw's running status in the macOS menu bar.
